limits: This call is necessity/plain wording only. All repairs must preserve conditions and receive affected correctness recheck; Stage3 reader understanding remains separate. No reader files edited.
overall: The length is mostly justified by the separate question/method/result accounts. No word-count target, chapter reduction or wholesale shortening recommended. One repeated paragraph can go; repair terms at their first dependent use rather than remove required content.

findings.problem: Repeats the three questions already stated in line7 and then each paper section. Quantitative motivation is already expressed by connecting cell assumptions to predictions and by the concrete questions/results. Last sentence only announces prediction/test/uncertainty, which the three accounts then deliver.
findings.deletion_test: Removing this paragraph leaves field, concrete tasks, method roles, all paper-specific problems, each reason it matters, methods, results, numerical eye estimate and all limits intact. The connection from line7 to the memory question remains natural.
findings.repair: Delete the line9 paragraph. Do not remove any of the three paper accounts or their limits.

findings.problem: Ideal observer first appears before its meaning is taught. The novice can mistake it for an actual observer or an extra empirical measurement. Its purpose is the best possible estimation accuracy under the model.
findings.deletion_test: The distinction between a best possible reader and an arbitrary reader is needed for the bound; deleting the estimation clause would lose a required method/result connection.
findings.repair: Replace the final clause with wording such as: and relate the motion to the best accuracy possible when estimating the stored value from those signals. This retains the contribution without introducing ideal-observer terminology.

findings.problem: Under the calibration and covariance assumptions signals a real limit but does not tell the reader what has to hold. Covariance is first taught in Chapter1, after this opening. Calibration was described as a procedure in line23, but the transfer assumption and separate-noise assumption are not yet clear.
findings.deletion_test: The assumptions limit the 82% inference and must remain; deleting them to shorten the paragraph would widen the claim.
findings.repair: State the conditions briefly in ordinary words, for example: assuming the fitted movement relation also holds during fixation and the relevant noise contributions do not vary together. Keep 350 ms, 82%, horizontal displacement variance, upstream location and the non-unique circuit conclusion.

findings.deletion_test: Keep the comparisons because they explain how the guide examples teach limits, and keep the notation convention if it is useful for consulting original papers. A label alone adds no needed teaching.
findings.problem: The scope comparison uses incomplete readout and rare-excursion approximation before these ideas are taught; line61 gives unexplained MSD and t within a notation equation. The scope has a useful role, but these labels add avoidable decoding work at the entrance.
findings.repair: At line57 use complete versus limited access to neural signals, and exact formulas versus approximations for rare fields, or an equally accurate plain explanation. At line61 expand mean squared displacement (MSD) and say t is elapsed time. A brief note that detailed meanings are taught in Chapter1 is sufficient for this reference paragraph. Sync the scope summary in YAML if changed.

findings.problem: Additional gain fitting is consequential, because it limits the claim that parameters already set elsewhere determine every test. Gain in this sense is only taught later in Chapter4. A source footnote can be read immediately from this frontmatter.
findings.deletion_test: Do not delete the qualifier: that would remove the distinction between spatial parameters and the extra fitted firing-rate scale.
findings.repair: Replace gain fitting with a plain description such as: Some firing-rate comparisons also fit a scale converting model output into firing rate. Retain the wiring/measurement distinction.

first_teaching_judgment: Place cell/place field at frontmatter line29 and fixational drift at line21 have adequate plain definitions for the orientation. Ledger records are appropriate. Foundations retains the fuller rate-map instruction; moving first teaching does not justify deleting that detail.
